title: Editor prints error about not finding editor nodes due to invalid MeshInstance3D Skeleton property
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.beta3.official [06acfccf8]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

When I play a scene, the editor prints an error. It seems to be related to the _editor itself_, the game works just fine.

```plaintext
E 0:00:01:0197   get_node: Node not found: "../../root/@EditorNode@21269/@Panel@14/@VBoxContainer@15/DockHSplitLeftL/DockHSplitLeftR/DockHSplitMain/@VBoxContainer@26/DockVSplitCenter/@VSplitContainer@54/@VBoxContainer@55/@EditorMainScreen@102/MainScreen/@CanvasItemEditor@11479/@VSplitContainer@11131/@HSplitContainer@11133/@HSplitContainer@11135/@Control@11136/@SubViewportContainer@11137/@SubViewport@11138/level_3rooms" (relative to "/root/level_3rooms/VisibilityCube/CollisionShape3D/MeshInstance3D").
  <C++ Error>    Method/function failed. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>   scene/main/node.cpp:1877 @ get_node()
```

Also when I delete the (offending?) MeshInstance3D and then _Ctrl+Z_ it back into existance, it also prints an error. I think it's the same error. So this happens in editor too.

1. Initial state

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4b90f662-13a4-4d4a-8eba-4609caa1f932)

2. I delete the rigidbody altogether, so the MeshInstance3D is also gone

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1af517dc-2f9c-49a6-8255-1b9f576f8653)

3. Ctrl+Z, the entire thing pops back in and the error is printed

```plaintext
E 0:00:01:0197   get_node: Node not found: "../../root/@EditorNode@21269/@Panel@14/@VBoxContainer@15/DockHSplitLeftL/DockHSplitLeftR/DockHSplitMain/@VBoxContainer@26/DockVSplitCenter/@VSplitContainer@54/@VBoxContainer@55/@EditorMainScreen@102/MainScreen/@CanvasItemEditor@11479/@VSplitContainer@11131/@HSplitContainer@11133/@HSplitContainer@11135/@Control@11136/@SubViewportContainer@11137/@SubViewport@11138/level_3rooms" (relative to "/root/level_3rooms/VisibilityCube/CollisionShape3D/MeshInstance3D").
  <C++ Error>    Method/function failed. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>   scene/main/node.cpp:1877 @ get_node()
```

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b0949c5-d1e5-48a6-a57a-f1a3cfb5befa)

4. Weird thing: When I delete the _VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D_ (which doesn't really do anything, I don't have occlusion enabled, I was just playing around), it prints an error too

```plaintext
E 0:00:01:0197   get_node: Node not found: "../../root/@EditorNode@21269/@Panel@14/@VBoxContainer@15/DockHSplitLeftL/DockHSplitLeftR/DockHSplitMain/@VBoxContainer@26/DockVSplitCenter/@VSplitContainer@54/@VBoxContainer@55/@EditorMainScreen@102/MainScreen/@CanvasItemEditor@11479/@VSplitContainer@11131/@HSplitContainer@11133/@HSplitContainer@11135/@Control@11136/@SubViewportContainer@11137/@SubViewport@11138/level_3rooms" (relative to "/root/level_3rooms/VisibilityCube/CollisionShape3D/MeshInstance3D").
  <C++ Error>    Method/function failed. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>   scene/main/node.cpp:1877 @ get_node()
```
 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6a544c5-b46c-4820-a544-81ab01603afb)

### Steps to reproduce

I tried to reproduce it in a separate project. Here are the steps:

1. Create a 3D scene (named it "World")
2. Add MeshInstance3D
3. Give it a cube mesh
4. Give it a StandardMaterial3D
5. Give the material any old albedo texture
6. Back in the scene tree, right lick the MeshInstance3D, click _Reparent to New Node_, select CollisionShape3D
7. Error is printed
8. Right click the collision shape in the scene tree, click _Reparent to New Node_, select RigidBody3D
9. Two more errors are printed

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7aa8cdaa-46d5-4727-a9f9-cefba2a6a881)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18781454/repro.zip)
